object.name: moxsession_info_manager
object.description: Unprivileged read-only interface for observing active sessions.

s2c.name: sessions
s2c.description: Sent once when the manager is first created. May be an empty array.

s2c.name: session_added
s2c.description: Broadcast to all connected clients when any session is created.

s2c.name: session_removed
s2c.description: Broadcast to all connected clients when any session is destroyed.

c2s.name: get_session_info
c2s.description: Creates a moxsession_info_session object for the given session_id. The daemon immediately pushes all fields, followed by done. If the session does not exist, destroyed is sent instead.

c2s.name: get_session_info_by_pid

description.summary: create a per-session info object by leader PID

c2s.description: Creates a moxsession_info_session object for the session whose leader PID matches the given pid. The daemon immediately pushes all fields, followed by done. If no matching session exists, destroyed is sent instead.

arg.name: pid
arg.summary: leader PID of the session to query

object.name: moxsession_info_session
object.description: Provides information about a single session. All fields are pushed immediately on creation and re-sent if they change.

arg.name: timestamp
arg.summary: session start time (seconds since Unix epoch)

s2c.name: destroyed

description.summary: session has ended or did not exist

s2c.description: Sent when the session is destroyed or if the session_id passed to get_session_info was not found. The client should release this object.
